pois.name: Etz Hayyim Synagogue
pois.intro: The Etz Hayyim Synagogue is an Orthodox Jewish congregation and synagogue, located in Chania on the island of Crete, in Greece. Constructed as a church, the building was converted into a synagogue in the 17th century.

pois.name: Μουσείο Τυπογραφίας
pois.intro: The Museum of Typography is a Greek museum of typography and printing located near Chania, Crete, at the Park of Small Industries in Souda. It was founded by Yannis Garedakis, owner and founder of the local newspaper Haniotika Nea, with the support of his wife Eleni.

pois.name: Venetian Lighthouse
pois.intro: Chania Lighthouse, is a lighthouse located at the entrance of the port of Chania, on the island of Crete, Greece. It was built in 1864 on the site of the original lighthouse by the Venetians.

pois.name: Κυδωνία
pois.intro: Kydonia, also known as Cydonia was an ancient city located at the site of present-day Chania near the west end of the island of Crete in Greece. The city is known from archaeological remains dating back to the Minoan era as well as literary and historical sources.

pois.name: Απτέρα
pois.intro: Aptera or Apteron was an ancient city, now an archaeological site in Kalives in western Crete, a kilometre inland from the southern shore of Souda Bay, about 13 km east of the city of Chania in the municipality of Chania.

pois.name: Αρχαιολογικό Μουσείο Χανίων
pois.intro: The Archaeological Museum of Chania is a archaeology museum serving the Cretean city of Chania that, since 2022, is located at 15 Skra Str. Chalepa.

pois.name: Άγιος Νικόλαος
pois.intro: The Church of Saint Nicholas is a Greek Orthodox church located in the Splanzia square in the town of Chania, on the island of Crete, Greece. It is dedicated to Saint Nicholas.

pois.name: Ναυτικό Μουσείο Κρήτης
pois.intro: The Maritime Museum of Crete is a museum in Chania, Crete, Greece. Its collection includes models of ships, nautical instruments, painting, historical photographs and war relics.

pois.name: Οικία Ελευθερίου Βενιζέλου
pois.intro: Eleftherios Venizelos Museum of Chalepa is an historic house museum in Chania, Crete, Greece. It is the paternal house of Eleftherios Venizelos, where he lived from 1880 to 1910, and occasionally, from 1927 to 1935.

pois.name: Aptera theatre
pois.intro: Das Theater von Aptera ist ein Theaterbau der griechischen Antike im Nordosten der griechischen Insel Kreta. Es befindet sich in der antiken Stadt Aptera beim Ort Aptera im Regionalbezirk Chania am Südrand der bis zu 231 Meter hohen Hochfläche des Berges Paleokastro.

pois.name: Φρούριο Απτέρων
pois.intro: Le château d'Áptera, également connu sous le nom de forteresse d'Áptera, ainsi que sous le nom de tour d'Áptera ou tour de Soúmpasis, est un château situé à proximité du village d'Áptera, sur l'île de Crète, en Grèce. Le château est construit au cours de la période ottomane, plus précisément entre 1867 et 1868, peu de temps après l'insurrection crétoise de 1866.

pois.name: Στύλος
pois.intro: Stylos is an archaeological site of an ancient Minoan settlement and cemetery near the modern village of Stylos on the Greek island of Crete. Stylos means "column" in Greek.

pois.name: Φρούριο Φιρκά
pois.intro: Το Φρούριο Φίρκα είναι ενετικό φρούριο που βρίσκεται στη βορειοδυτική πλευρά του παλιού λιμανιού των Χανίων, στην Κρήτη. Κατασκευάστηκε από τους Βενετούς στα μέσα του 16ου αιώνα με σκοπό την άμυνα της εισόδου του λιμανιού.

pois.name: Αδέσποτο Μουσική Ταβέρνα
pois.description: Adespoto music taverna is an open-air restaurant located in the leafy ruins of a historic Venetian townhouse in the old town of Chania, Crete.

pois.name: Πλατεία 1821 (Σπλάντζιας)
pois.intro: Η πλατεία της Σπλάντζιας, επισήμως γνωστή ως Πλατεία 1821, βρίσκεται στην ανατολική πλευρά της παλιάς πόλης των Χανίων στην Κρήτη. Η Σπλάντζια αποτελούσε το κέντρο της πόλης κατά την Τουρκοκρατία, καθώς ήταν η παλιά και μεγαλύτερη συνοικία των μουσουλμάνων.

pois.name: Στύλου - Κατωχωρίου Δήμου Αρμένων και Κεραμειών

terminalResolution.notes: Ships berth at Souda's cruise berth (OpenStreetMap 'Cruise Berth Point'); a bus and taxis run to Chania, about 7 km away. Renamed Chania (Souda).
